subject: SentryBridge GRC <> Redwood - evidence sync & onboarding
messages:
From: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partnerships@sentrybridge.com
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: SentryBridge <> Redwood - initial integration & evidence flow

Marissa —

Thanks for the intro (and congrats on the recent Dedicated launch). SentryBridge builds a tenant-aware GRC layer that customers use to pull SOC2/pen-test artifacts into their control workflows. We think there’s a clear integration path where Redwood could push verified evidence pointers (and optionally zipped artifacts) into SentryBridge so our customers can auto-attach L1/L2 artifacts to control outputs.

High level ask: can we run a short onboarding to map artifact types, required access patterns (S3 presigned links vs. direct upload), and SLA expectations for evidence retention? We can share a draft SLA and a short evidence-mapping template.

Proposed attendees: myself (Luis), Alyssa Ng (PenTrust Labs, our pen-test partner), and your security/compliance lead. Do you have a standard evidence template we prefer?

Attached: SentryBridge integration brief (stub).

—Luis
Head of Partnerships, SentryBridge
[luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com]
[Attachment: sentrybridge-integration-brief.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SentryBridge <> Redwood - initial integration & evidence flow

Luis —

Thanks for reaching out, happy to run the onboarding. Quick answers up front: we support both presigned S3 object references (preferred for large artifacts) and direct upload to a secure evidence bucket; we have an evidence-mapping template we use for SOC2/pen-test handoffs.

Next steps I propose:
- 30-40 minute scoping call this week to align on artifact types, retention policies, and whether SentryBridge will store artifacts or only index pointers.
- Share our evidence-mapping template and a short SLA draft from SentryBridge; we can iterate offline.

Attendees from our side: Vanessa (partnerships lead), Ben (sales lead for platform integrations), and our security partner (I’ll loop Neha if we need to sign an evidence-sharing agreement).

Can you do 10/19 or 10/20 morning PT? If you send the template and the SLA draft ahead of the call that will speed the mapping exercise.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (stub)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SentryBridge <> Redwood - initial integration & evidence flow

Luis / Marissa —

I’ll be on the call to cover technical controls and tokenized access patterns. A couple quick items we’d like clarified before the call so we can scope the engineering effort:

1) Attachment sizes and frequency: do you expect regular batch pushes of large artifacts (100s MB) or mostly small JSON/HTML reports?
2) Retention + access model: will SentryBridge request object lifecycle deletion, or will Redwood retain on customer request and provide pointers to SentryBridge?
3) Audit trail expectations: do you require envelope signing of artifacts (hash + signature) or is an S3 ETag + access log sufficient?

Also, Alyssa from PenTrust Labs was mentioned — if she will share a summary pen-test report, please include a redacted copy and a short scope note; internal legal/security would want to confirm PII handling.

I’ve attached a short tech checklist we use for partner evidence ingestion so we can walk through during the sync.

—Karthik
Senior Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rbw-tech-checklist.md (stub)]

From: Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@pentrustlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SentryBridge <> Redwood - initial integration & evidence flow

Team —

Attaching the pen-test executive summary and a redacted full report (PII scrubbed). We can also provide a short manifest CSV that lists artifacts by control ID — that often helps automation.

DocuSign: Luis has prepared a short evidence-exchange MOU; here’s the DocuSign link for signatures: https://www.docusign.com/sign/REDWOOD-SENTRY-ONBOARD-2026

Attachments: penreport-summary-2026-09.pdf (redacted), evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (completed example)

If you prefer, I can join the scoping call on 10/21 PT to walk through the artifact manifest.

—Alyssa Ng
Senior Consultant, PenTrust Labs
[Attachment: penreport-summary-2026-09.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: evidence-mapping-template-complete.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Luis Herrera <luis.herrera@sentrybridge.com>, Alyssa Ng <alyssa.ng@pentrustlabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SentryBridge <> Redwood - evidence sync & next steps

Thanks all — good set of artifacts and thank you Alyssa for the redacted report. Quick summary and next steps:

- Call scheduled: 10/21 10:30 AM PT (30 min) — agenda: artifact types, upload pattern (presigned S3 vs. direct), retention & delete flows, audit trail format.
- Action items before call:
  * Luis: share final SLA draft (SentryBridge) and confirm whether SentryBridge will store artifacts or index pointers only.
  * Alyssa: please bring the artifact manifest CSV to the call (helps Karthik map controls).
  * Karthik: we’ll share a minimal ingestion S3 policy and a pointer schema (JSON) for evidence metadata.
  * Neha: review MOU/DocuSign for privacy obligations; I’ve asked legal to queue review if MOU is accepted.

I’ve attached our evidence-mapping template and a short checklist for the call. If anyone needs to reschedule, put options into the thread.

See you on the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-evidence-mapping-template.xlsx (updated)]
